main_point: The four-paper mathematical edition is accepted. This packet proposes comparable counts for the three available original PDFs, all five replacement papers and both complete required programs. The missing L108 PDF prevents a complete four-source PDF factor.
common_acquisition: The whole 10-page common paper U_C is charged to this topic, without credit for overlap with another topic.
required_mathematical_program: Both complete GAP programs are charged once: the 4-page printed appendix is the primary representation; full raw program text is a separate alternative. No diagnostic portions are pruned.
boundary: Whole physical PDFs, including title, abstract, bibliography and acknowledgements. Only exact repeated navigation/running furniture/page numbers are removed. Raw untrimmed, raw selected and calibrated selected counts remain visible under NFC and NFKC.
conditional_policy: A local factor, when later admitted, is c(source_i)/c(C_i) after acquiring the whole U_C and both complete required programs. The L108 numerator stays null and C3 stays in the complete-topic denominator.

source_scope.full_source_main_result_comparison: Full manuscript length is the intended numerator for the accepted main-result contracts; this does not assert recovery of every auxiliary or historical claim.
explicit_qualifications: L088 J10 has the accepted figure/label qualification.
N013 N13 is qualified; N14 comparison with another classification and N15 unused semiregular isomorphism are excluded; N16 is background.
L108 P4 unconditional faithful-action assertion is replaced by the exact kernel criterion; source original PDF remains unavailable.
F014 uses the exact v1 edition and corrected left-action convention. Conjecture3.7 belongs to the separate question track.

known_cost_limits: External retained proofs, classifications/catalogue construction, graphics and formula layout have unknown cost, not zero. The extracted-text count is not a complete visible-text or total research-effort count.
formal_validation: The 16 checked declarations and their Lean/GAP infrastructure are separately reported validation. They do not make all geometric and source-specific assertions formal.
authored_browser_text: The available L108 authored browser text is hash-bound only as an admitted source representation. It is not substituted for its missing PDF.
required_environment: Python 3 with pypdf version 6.13.0; primary PDFs supplied locally under the bound paths.
